sourceTitle: NOAA — How deep is the ocean?
exactSourceStatements: The deepest part of the ocean is called the Challenger Deep and is located beneath the western Pacific Ocean
It is named after the HMS Challenger, whose crew first sounded the depths of the trench in 1875.
